reviews.text: He's serious and professional, with a wealth of experience. I've even introduced him to other people I know, and they've been very happy with him. He's a genuine person who does his job with love and dedication!

I met Fabrizio shortly after adopting Yago, then 4 months old.
I was inexperienced, scared, and unable to read canine language.
We worked primarily on his social skills and on building trust through unique experiences outdoors and with other dogs.
Today, Yago is almost a year old, and I'm happy that he's a happy dog, not afraid, more balanced, and with better social skills.
I'm sure he wouldn't have been the same without this rich experience.🌟

Fabrizio helped us with our puppy Lillo—the first session was incredibly helpful; after just one hour, the dog was learning, and he taught us a lot about how to behave and train a puppy. I highly recommend him to anyone who needs to improve their relationship with their dog or puppy.

I've known Fabrizio for a couple of years, and he's the only person I trust with my Vicky!!! Fabrizio taught me to understand my dog's true needs. He taught me not to distort her and to find a balance so I can communicate with her... an excellent trainer!

I've been lucky enough to know Fabrizio for a few months, the same luck our beloved puppies have had 🐶 🐶 Fabrizio immediately connected with them and vice versa, his method has nothing to do with the thousand rules that overflow on social media. On the contrary, he creates a real bond with them made of woods and walks in the greenery that takes them back to the origins of this unique, special and ancient relationship between man and his most faithful friend. Thank you Fabrizio AD MAIORA

Two months ago I adopted Amanda, a very fearful dog who wouldn't even leave the house. I was really worried, but thanks to Fabrizio's help and his simple, clear advice, I learned how to deal with the situation. In just a few lessons, he instilled so much confidence in me, and now I see my dog ​​improving day by day. Fabrizio is a keen observer, a listener, patient, and helpful. I wholeheartedly recommend him!

Fabrizio knows and understands dogs like few others. His knowledge also helps owners better understand the canine world; his advice has been invaluable in caring for my dog. He's absolutely trustworthy!

Fabrizio is a wonderful person! We had the pleasure of meeting him 6 years ago to give my Amstaff a little bit of a makeover and try to understand each other better. With so much patience and devotion, he gave us a huge hand, turning my blue fawn Amstaff Dries into a very sweet and moderate model dog. Now it's the turn of Mia, Dries's furry little sister, a crossbreed rescued from the kennel.

I really don't know where to begin to explain who Fabrizio is and what he meant for bringing Lucky into our family. He's not a trainer or a "trendy" behaviorist. He's a loving, professional, precise, and understanding educator, capable of understanding (and educating) the owners of their four-legged friends first and foremost. We adopted this puppy at an estimated age of 6 months, with a difficult past history (he had already been through two homes, with a history of probable abuse or a lack of socialization). As a mother of a 6-year-old, I had pondered this adoption for a year, wanting to give this new family member all the love he needed, ensure he didn't lack anything, and make my son understand that this wouldn't be a game. Despite his energetic temperament, Lucky showed signs of aggression when he arrived home. At first, I thought it was a consequence of his young age, but after a few days, I realized something was actually wrong and immediately tried to fix it. I came across Fabrizio's profile, and after an initial chat and meeting, we embarked on a personalized program designed specifically to help Lucky "reset" his negative start to life. Fabrizio, in a very short time, helped Lucky understand that, with education, socialization, and love, you can be fearless. And he taught me how to behave with him. Trust Fabrizio, because he knows exactly what to do and understands that every dog ​​is unique and that every dog ​​needs its own unique journey. Lucky has undergone a huge transformation; he's happy and perfectly integrated into our family. Our personalized program
with Fabrizio recently ended, but we'll continue with walks in the woods. We can't thank you enough, Fabrizio. You'll forever be in Lucky's heart, and in ours too.

I called Fabrizio for a professional opinion, and without even knowing each other, he was incredibly kind and helpful in explaining his perspective on a very specific issue in a thorough and accessible manner. 10/10.

Fabrizio is an exceptional person, very professional. Thanks to him, my little girl has improved a lot, today I can manage her, and only thanks to him, we did an excellent job following all his instructions, which with a husky is not easy 😂😂 congratulations, truly, thank you for everything ❤️ I recommend him with my eyes closed 🐾 my little girl already misses her little friends 😍😍

Fabrizio, in addition to being a competent and professional dog trainer, has a sensitivity and empathy that few possess. Thanks to this, he is able to immediately connect with both his furry clients and their owners. With me, he was able to go far beyond all this. I have a 13-year-old daughter who is terrified of dogs so much that the mere sight of a dog causes her to experience fear, anxiety, and panic attacks. Thanks to his interpersonal skills and expertise, Fabrizio was able to help my daughter approach dogs without fear or anxiety. He understood her, respected her, and taught her how to approach them. The result was amazing, and it was a joy to see her walking peacefully with her dogs on a leash.
